task: Educational topic retrieval, NOT medical prediction
dataset: 15 authored synthetic English queries; one author-assigned relevant topic each; not real patient questions
model: TF-IDF + cosine; word regex; catalog-only fitting; top 1; abstain on zero overlap
limitations: Tiny author-written evaluation, not independent or clinical validation
No paraphrase understanding; zero-overlap queries are withheld
Known-diabetes wording can overlap with testing terms
Only three English topics; no urgency assessment
